data.long_meaning: Aneela is derived from the Arabic word 'anīl, meaning 'helper'. In Islamic history, Aneela is a name given to those who assist and support others in their time of need. This name is rooted in the essence of compassion and kindness, evoking feelings of righteousness and wisdom. The name Aneela carries the meaning “Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aneela usually hope their child will grow to embody helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
